newsitem.title: UK: GEC, Alcatel mull power unit, Framatome tie.
newsitem.headline: GEC, Alcatel mull power unit, Framatome tie.

text.p: General Electric Co Plc said it and Alcatel Alsthom are considering to merge industrial plant maker GEC Alsthom and Framatome, the nuclear reactor builder in which Alcatel has a 44 percent stake.
"The pooling of complementary activities would establish a group with the capability to produce both nuclear and conventional power generating plant," GEC said in a statement.
A merged entity would have annual sales over 12 billion Ecus and more than 90,000 employees worldwide.
"It is envisaged that shares in the new group would be held by the present shareholders of the companies involved bearing in mind their respective contributions," GEC added.
Framatome is controlled by the French state. Earlier this month it reported a 147 percent surge in its first-half net attributable profit to 578 million French francs.
GEC-Alsthom is jointly owned by GEC and Alcatel Alsthom.
The British and French governments have been informed of the plan to explore a merger between the joint venture and Framatome, GEC said.
